scope: Owner-supplied Calendar slideout copy for the 2026 Venus retrograde in Scorpio. Dates remain calculated; this copy is not a planetary calendar.
previousBody: Venus retrogrades in nearly the same place every eight years. This is the last day it stood where it stations today. Reflect back to that time: what you valued, who you were close to, and what felt unresolved may be worth revisiting now.
nextBody: Venus returns to retrace this stretch of sky, stationing a little earlier in Scorpio and moving back into Libra on Oct 18.
